newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower, trims earlier losses.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower, trims earlier losses.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mostly lower but managed to recoup earlier losses thanks to spillover from a general recovery in U.S. wheat markets, traders said.
Profit taking in the December/March spread and a drop in short covering drove nearby MGE December wheat more than 10 cents per bushel lower at the midsession.
But a lack of followthrough selling of the December prodded values higher toward the close. The Dec/March spread, which had narrowed to 25 cents during the downturn, closed at 31-1/4 cents.
MGE spring wheat closed 1/2 cent higher to 3-1/4 cents lower, with Dec down 3-1/4 cents at $4.23-1/4. March shed 1/2 cent to close at $3.92.

Traders said Wilson Trading sold three million bushels of the Dec/March spread at 28 to 31 cents. Atwood/Peavey bull-spread 1.3 million Dec/March. CIS and LFG each bought around 500,000 bushels of the spread. CIS also bought 1.2 million Dec and Wilson bought 1.4 million March, traders said.
MGE December barley futures did not trade Tuesday.
